info.name: Team-Flex API
info.description:
Every endpoint of the Team-Flex server (Express, /api), generated from server/scripts/postman/generate-postman.ts.

**How to use:** import this collection and the environment `Team-Flex · local`, select the environment, start the server (`npm run dev` in server/), then **Run collection** (Collection Runner). Folder 00 creates a fresh sandbox organization (owner + member + guest) and every later request reuses its tokens and ids.

**Auth:** Bearer `{{accessToken}}` on the collection (overridden per request for member / guest / platform / public). The header `X-Organization-Id` is added automatically. The refresh token is the httpOnly cookie `tf_refresh`, kept by Postman's cookie jar.

**Scenarios:** each request has a test for the expected status, so the negative cases (400 validation, 401, 403 permissions, 404, 409 conflicts) are part of the run.
